recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, centered portrait of a performer with a large afro and white mime makeup, captured in a moment of intense vocalization or screaming against a dark, textured background.
coreVisualRelationships: The circular silhouette of the afro framing the oval of the white-painted face
The stark contrast between the white face paint and the dark hair/background
The vertical alignment of the open mouth with the central axis of the composition
The textural contrast between the soft hair and the sharp, defined lines of the makeup
coreInvariants: White greasepaint face with black vertical tear-line details
Wide-open mouth showing teeth and tongue
Red ribbed garment at the base

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centrally located, filling approximately 80% of the vertical frame from the chest up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The open mouth and exposed teeth serve as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes are drawn to the bright white face, then drop to the dark cavity of the mouth, then move outward to the texture of the hair.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dark, vignetted space in the corners emphasizes the central figure.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep charcoal and black (background and hair)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between face and hair; low saturation overall with the exception of the red shirt.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to black, white, red, and skin tones

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used for both top and bottom text for consistency.
graphicDevices: Text placement follows the curve of the clothing or hair

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the tight, vertical, and bold nature of the original type.
Provides the necessary weight and condensed structure.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of a man with a large black afro, wearing white mime makeup with black vertical lines through the eyes, screaming with mouth wide open, wearing a red ribbed turtleneck, against a dark textured background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add centered, all-caps, condensed sans-serif text in a light cream color at the very top and bottom of the frame.

verificationChecks: Is the face paint stark white?
Is the mouth wide open showing teeth?
Is the afro perfectly circular and framing the face?
Is the text condensed and all-caps?

adjustableVariables: Specific pattern of the mime makeup lines
mustRedesign: Specific brand logos in the corners
Exact grain/noise pattern of the vintage print
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the afro is the dominant shape
Verify the red shirt has a ribbed texture
Confirm text is legible but secondary to the image
recipe.reuseFormula: Centralized theatrical portrait + high-contrast makeup + spherical framing element + condensed sans-serif typography.
